summary_of_work: Read THREAT_MODEL.md, AUDIT.md (components, rules), the campaign context, and the delivery code: src/send-cmio-response.cpp; machine::send_cmio_response, log_send_cmio_response, verify_send_cmio_response and check_cmio_response_revert_root_hash (src/machine.cpp); record/replay send-cmio state accessors; state_access::write_memory_with_padding; machine::write_memory/fill_memory; the Lua (clua-i-machine.cpp), C (cm.cpp) and JSON-RPC client/server wrappers (encode_cmio_response_data substitutes rx_len+1 zero bytes for oversized data, which keeps the no-op); interpret() fixed-point ordering and get_state_break_reason; uarch-run.cpp mcycle_end wrap at UINT64_MAX (harmless: the imcyclemax check comes first); the regenerated SendCmioResponse.sol; Dave v3.0.0-alpha.7 released CartesiStateTransition (input witness, zero-root no-input rule, toUint32) and DaveConsensus.provideMerkleRootOfInput (LibMath.ceilLog2(0)=0, so a zero-length input gets a nonzero root and a dataLength-0 delivery, consistent with C++); the PRT player (prt.lua begin_input/load_cmio_input, run_to_input_mcycle_offset, run_to_epoch_input_offset, run_next_input/epoch_stopped, prove_state_transition, run_to_uarch_cycle, build_uarch_cycle_computation_hash, collect_uarch_cycle_bundle revert tail, revert_root_hash bookkeeping), the referee model validate_state_transition_response, prt-ethereum transition_proof/verify_transition, prt-bridge winLeafMatch, vg.lua delivery paths, and the cartesi-machine CLI delivery loop. All agree with R5/R6 and with each other.
experiments: Bare-metal command-driven guest (scratch cmd.c/cmd.bin): reached accepted yield, rejected yield, halt, TX_EXCEPTION yield, manual yield with reason 7, accepted yield at mcycle 2^64-2^47 (imcyclemax saturation), stop at saturated imcyclemax by spinning, stop at imcyclemax with an automatic yield pending (iflags.X=1 at mcycle=imcyclemax=2^64-1, reachable), and an accepted yield exactly at mcycle 2^64-1. At each, delivered inputs of length 0, 1, 31, 32, 33, 65536, 2^21 (exact rx size) and 2^21+1 through: native send_cmio_response on a twin machine, log_send_cmio_response, C++ verify_send_cmio_response, C++ verify_step_uarch of the following step, and the regenerated Solidity on the shared StepVerifier anvil (sendCmioResponse and sendCmioResponseThenStep, eth_call only). 0 disagreements, no throws; no-op exactly in the R5 cases (exp.lua).

Odd rx contents: after a 2 MiB delivery of 0xff, delivered shorter inputs (0..2^20+1 bytes): native, log, C++ verify and EVM agree (odd.lua). The rx buffer is not guest-writable (PMA W=0), so odd contents only come from earlier deliveries.

Dave released CartesiStateTransition (deployed bytecode from work/dave/released, CM_MARCHID 23, i.e. built on the regenerated step) via eth_call with stateOverride and a constant-root mock provider: input-opening counters for input slots 0, 1 and 2^24-1, inputs of length 1, 32, 33, 65536 and 0 (root of one zero leaf, as DaveConsensus computes), at all the states above, plus empty slots (zero root, inputLength 0, step only): 112/112 agree with the emulator, including the no-op deliveries (dave.lua).

eth_estimateGas of that transitionState call for the largest InputBox input (EvmAdvance of 65,508 nonzero bytes, proof 93,964 bytes): 3,768,920 gas, dominated by the EIP-7623 calldata floor. This excludes Tournament.winLeafMatch overhead and the provider's Merkle-root computation, but leaves a wide margin under the 2^24 per-transaction cap even after the bridge's 2x estimate.
not_covered: Full Tournament.winLeafMatch and DaveConsensus.provideMerkleRootOfInput executed on a real chain with InputBox inputs (I used a mock provider returning the Lua-computed input root; the provider's own Merkle code was only read). The shared chain on 8547 was not running and I did not deploy.
Delivery at an accepted yield with mcycle >= imcyclemax without saturation (needs a 2^48-mcycle run). I only tested the saturated variant (yield at mcycle 2^64-1); the arithmetic path is the same.
Delivery logs and verifiers under a non-Keccak hash function (log producers refuse it by design).
JSON-RPC send/log/verify_send_cmio_response were read, not run remotely (the forked PRT player path).
The PRT player end to end (crisium + bridge + chain) on no-op deliveries after an epoch stop or saturation; only its code paths were read. The player-restart runner was not run.
Linux guest (libcmt / rollup tools) handling of inputs of exactly the rx size and of a zero-length advance; only bare-metal guests were used.
Gas refund economics of winLeafMatch (Gas.WIN_LEAF_MATCH, CALLDATA_BYTE=16 against the EIP-7623 floor of 40 per byte): economic, not completeness; not pursued.
ASan/UBSan build: not run on the delivery paths.
